description: The Ortto plugin for WordPress before 1.0.25 did not authenticate configuration update requests, relying only on a secret exposed in public HTML. An unauthenticated threat actor could overwrite the plugin's configuration to serve arbitrary scripts.

The Ortto plugin for WordPress before 1.0.25 did not escape stored settings on its admin settings page, leading to stored cross-site scripting. The Ortto plugin for WordPress before 1.0.25 did not filter the WooCommerce product data it embedded in public storefront pages. An unauthenticated threat actor could read product passwords and private product metadata from an affected store.
